concurrency: Single owning writer; finalize and abort are mutually exclusive; recovery is read-only and may run concurrently with nothing that writes.
inputs: existing manifest and stream bytes on recovery
outputs: writer state transitions and durable stream/manifest bytes
purpose: Enforce exactly one owning writer per run, the new to open to closed / open to failed state machine, the documented flush/fsync/atomic-replace boundaries, and a bounded non-mutating recovery that never rewrites, upgrades or deletes original evidence bytes.
state: Owns the single-writer state, the open stream handle and the durable manifest/stream bytes for the run; no other component writes them.

static_checks.expected: ast.parse succeeds for every planned path; exclusive creation, mutually exclusive finalize/abort and a write-free recovery path are present
static_checks.rule: python ast parse of the planned writer/recovery sources plus a check that open uses exclusive creation, finalize and abort are mutually exclusive and the recovery path performs no write, rename or unlink
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

static_checks.expected: ast analysis finds no Path.read_bytes()/unbounded read() on the manifest or stream and finds an O_NOFOLLOW bounded read helper used by both recovery and writer finalize/abort
static_checks.rule: no unbounded read()/read_bytes() is applied to the manifest or evidence stream; recovery and the writer's finalize/abort stream read use a bounded helper opened with O_NOFOLLOW and an explicit max_bytes; the manifest is republished only after the actual-byte bound check
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

title: ARGUS2-SR-006-U unit specification - Single-writer state, durability and non-mutating recovery

unit_cases.expected: writer_state is 'open' before finalize and 'closed' after; no other transition occurs
unit_cases.precondition: a freshly opened run that finalizes cleanly
unit_cases.stimulus: read run.writer_state before and after finalize()

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-STATE-ILLEGAL-TRANSITION; the closed stream and manifest are unchanged
ARGUS2-STATE-WRITER-CONFLICT; only one owning writer holds the run
unit_cases.precondition: an open run and a second writer opened on the same run root
unit_cases.stimulus: EvidenceStore.open_run(root, run_id=..., plan=plan) a second time

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-STATE-RUN-EXISTS; no new file is created inside or outside the root
the appended lines are present on disk after the documented flush+fsync point; flush_buffer is recorded as the only appended-line durability boundary
unit_cases.stimulus: run.flush_buffer() then inspect events.jsonl on disk

unit_cases.expected: manifest.json is the complete closed manifest, no manifest.json.tmp-* residue remains and the stream is internally consistent
unit_cases.stimulus: run.finalize() then inspect the run root

unit_cases.expected: writer_state becomes 'failed'; the previous manifest bytes remain; a diagnostic ARGUS2-IO-FAILURE is reported; the stream bytes are unchanged
unit_cases.precondition: os.replace patched to raise during the finalize manifest replacement

unit_cases.expected: writerState is 'failed'; a best-effort run-failed record is appended when the stream is usable; evidenceStatus is not 'complete'
unit_cases.precondition: an open run aborted by the caller

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-CORRUPT-STREAM-TRUNCATED; the damaged line is not counted as an accepted event and is never repaired
unit_cases.precondition: the trailing newline removed from the last JSONL line

unit_cases.expected: valid records up to the damage are returned, the damage is reported, and every original file byte (stream and manifest) is unchanged after the read
unit_cases.precondition: a run root containing a truncated tail and several valid records

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-STATE-RUN-EXISTS; the reader path remains the only re-open and it is read-only
only the versioned JSONL stream and the JSON manifest are created by the writer; no lock file, database, temporary residue or index is left behind
unit_cases.precondition: an open run with appended events
unit_cases.stimulus: enumerate the run root after flush_buffer

unit_cases.expected: the symlink is rejected before I/O with ARGUS2-PATH-SYMLINK and the oversized stream with ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_event_bytes/max_events; no unbounded read()/read_bytes() of the stream occurs (ARGUS2-ADV-01, ARGUS2-ADV-02)
unit_cases.precondition: a stream/manifest path that is a symlink, and a stream larger than the caller event bound
unit_cases.stimulus: recovery/recovery helper and EvidenceStore.read_run under the caller limits

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_manifest_bytes; the on-disk manifest bytes remain the prior open manifest; the writer is not reported 'closed' and no complete persistence is claimed (ARGUS2-ADV-06)
unit_cases.precondition: an open run with a valid open manifest and a caller max_manifest_bytes such that the closed manifest (with artifact index, obligations and finalized metadata) exceeds it

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_manifest_bytes; the prior manifest bytes remain and no closed/complete claim is made (ARGUS2-ADV-06)
unit_cases.precondition: an open run and a caller max_manifest_bytes such that the abort/failed manifest exceeds it
